human_notification.opt_in: trusted immutable company_id + doc_id UUID reference at register log_audit
human_notification.timing: after successful owned physical business root commit; in-memory best effort
human_notification.recipients: current existing User with current email, explicit current UserCompany, existing assert_company_product docs, existing _can_doc read with record_break_glass_use=False
human_notification.freshness: new Session per recipient; reread current rule/enabled/via_email/category/selection/admins-only and native admission immediately before each handoff
human_notification.identity_context: no JWT impersonation; public native_claims_context plus scope/org save/reset on all paths

compatibility.doc_uuid: native UUID subclasses admitted then canonical UUID value snapshotted
compatibility.business_register: only one opt-in log_audit keyword; counter/order/outbox/final check/seal/commit unchanged
compatibility.queue: existing ownership guards, physical root/SAVEPOINT poison and retirement-before-callback semantics retained
compatibility.publisher: URL/internal-app publisher byte-unchanged, separate residual OPEN

limits: READ COMMITTED multi-query eligibility is not a single atomic policy snapshot
A revoke committed before the fresh check begins suppresses; concurrent changes during its separate reads can race
No lease or locks through SMTP; in-flight handoff cannot be recalled
Candidate IDs bound a batch; newly added recipients after candidate selection wait for a future event
No durable retry, exactly-once, transport success guarantee or rollback of committed registration
Direct handler PG definitions do not prove HTTP ingress, production delivery or full CI

verification.static: Python 3.13 AST and memory compile, source/hash comparison only
verification.bootstrap: runtime owner must isolate ancestor conftest before imports, provide full native schema/codecs/constraints and root-owned disposable cleanup; no old world fixture

cross_cutting_requirements.requirement: Все20M и все поверхности Core/Support/Auditor классифицированы; обязательные документы/контрагенты/договоры/ЭЗС/оборудование/accounts не исчерпывают объём.
Точный актуальный source/runtime/consumer baseline; не потерять параллельные live исправления.
Единственный владелец правила, tenant/object/org/date scope до count/limit/aggregate/export, текущие actor/grants; неизвестная операция fail-closed.
OpenAPI/Swagger/SDK/runtime совпадают, содержат реальные auth, errors, headers, limits, null-intent, examples; binary/multipart/SSE/WS/webhook/industry profiles проверяются отдельно.
Старые golden outputs и отрицательные матрицы двух компаний/пользователей/apps/resources, реальные SQL/bytes там где требуется; metadata count не заменяет ACL assertion.
Fresh/restore/upgrade/repeat/old-code, checksums, locking и rollback; перед working migration свежая backup и фактическое восстановление.
Полный перевод согласованных UI/service consumers, без stale-context effects и silent fallback; usage evidence перед retirement.
SQL/RAM/latency/pool/cache/exports/jobs на представительном объёме и принятые бюджеты, без необоснованных pool/index changes.
Единый окончательный состав исходников и соответствующие проверки; разные frozen серии не объявляются общим полным CI.
Фактическая приёмка выбранного release/ingress/SSO/callback/CORS/ordinary employee и партнёров; synthetic localhost не подменяет её.
Ревью человеком/согласованный состав/откат; merge и рабочая активация отдельны от зелёных тестов.
